name: Qixoid

dimension._note: z = x*y = 1 player * 5 min avg session = 5

description: A modern 3D take on the 1981 arcade classic Qix. Claim territory on the surface of a parametric snail shell while meandering plasma Qix entities — each with writhing tentacles — hunt your unfinished filament. If a tentacle or core touches your live filament, the fill is destroyed and you lose a life. Bigger fills pay disproportionately more. Capture 80 percent of the surface to win.

controls.Hold LMB: stake out a filament (live and dangerous)
